milestones.name: Defeat Egis
milestones.note: First boss encountered in the game; unlocks early progression. Trophy: First Kill.

milestones.name: Defeat Calderon
milestones.note: Rewards the Old-Fashioned Key upon defeat.

milestones.name: Defeat Sol & Vin
milestones.note: Dual boss encounter. After defeat, climb to top before elevator and go right to find Lura's Seal.

milestones.name: Obtain Lura's Seal
milestones.note: Found by climbing to top before the elevator and going right after defeating Sol & Vin.

milestones.name: Defeat FLORA
milestones.note: Located before the Aviaries Passepartout. Go right after defeating FLORA to find the Aviaries Passepartout key item.

milestones.name: Obtain Aviaries Passepartout
milestones.note: Found to the right after defeating FLORA, located before the Aviaries.

milestones.name: Defeat Shii
milestones.note: Secret final boss of the True Ending path. Fought in The Library (elevator third level). Requires completing The Crucible, obtaining Flowing Steps, and climbing the gloom waterfall in the Canopy.

milestones.name: Defeat Sawlong
milestones.note: Chase boss during a story sequence. Must grapple onto enemies without touching the ground to escape. Trophy: Aerial Maneuver.

milestones.name: Obtain Flowing Steps
milestones.note: Required to reach Shii in The Library via the True Ending path.

milestones.name: Complete The Crucible
milestones.note: Required as part of the True Ending path before reaching Shii.

zones.name: The Vessel
zones.note: The overarching world/setting in which all boss encounters take place.

zones.name: Early Game Area
zones.fingerprintHint: Location of Egis, first story boss.
zones.note: Early game area where Egis is encountered.

zones.name: The Library
zones.fingerprintHint: Elevator third level; location of Shii, secret True Ending final boss.
zones.note: Accessed via True Ending path; Shii is fought here at the elevator third level.

zones.name: The Crucible
zones.note: Must be completed as part of the True Ending path leading to Shii.

zones.name: The Canopy
zones.note: Contains a gloom waterfall that must be climbed on the True Ending path to reach Shii.

zones.name: Aviaries
zones.fingerprintHint: Area reached after obtaining the Aviaries Passepartout, found right of FLORA's arena.
zones.note: Area leading to Aviaries; FLORA is the boss located before the Aviaries Passepartout.

abilities.name: Hairpin Grapple
abilities.note: Core mobility ability recommended in all boss fights; used to maintain mobility during encounters. Also used in Sawlong chase to grapple onto enemies without touching the ground.

abilities.name: Allocation Matrix
abilities.note: System for optimizing combat abilities and modifiers; referenced as a core mechanic in all boss strategies.

abilities.name: Flowing Steps
abilities.note: Required to reach Shii; used to climb the gloom waterfall in the Canopy on the True Ending path.

abilities.name: Lura's Seal
abilities.note: Found after defeating Sol & Vin, by climbing to the top before the elevator and going right.

abilities.name: Aviaries Passepartout
abilities.note: Found to the right after defeating FLORA; grants access to the Aviaries area.
